name: 2one Solutions
about: 2one Solutions is a design and strategy consultancy helping businesses create structure in an ever-changing technology environment. We build business strategies that better connect you with your customers, leveraging our Design Language System architecture.
tagline: Building business value by improving customer & user experience.
mission: To create structure in an unstructured world.
vision: Help build companies that customers can't stop talking about.

voice.note: How the brand speaks — the enduring character of the language.

tone.note: How that voice adapts to context — reassuring where it matters, decisive where it counts.

do: Be minimal and contemporary — say it in fewer words.
Be factual and specific; show, don't hype.
Stay empathetic where the reader might be uncertain; be bold where a decision is needed.
dont: Don't add filler, jargon, or generic marketing fluff.
Don't use colour or emphasis as the only way to make a point.

usage_for_ai: Match this voice and tone for any 2one-facing copy. Do not invent brand facts not present here or in brand/BRAND.md.
